psychological_meaning: Celtic green embodies growth, harmony, and stability, rooted in nature and tradition. It evokes feelings of balance, endurance, and connection to the earth, often associated with the mystical and historical aspects of Celtic culture. This color promotes a sense of tranquility, renewal, and groundedness, fostering an environment of growth and well-being.

real_world_examples.title: Celtic Knot Jewelry
real_world_examples.description: Intricate Celtic knot designs in jewelry often feature deep greens, symbolizing eternal life and interconnectedness.

real_world_examples.title: Irish Landscapes
real_world_examples.description: The lush green landscapes of Ireland are a quintessential example of the color's natural beauty and association with the Celtic heritage.
